set_aside.subject: EffectApproval participation in operation element conclusion
set_aside.text: “the requested approval decides it” contradicts “Read from the NodeExecution and EffectAttempt together; the trace is the only source”
set_aside.question: Is EffectApproval an authoritative input to operation_element_conclusion, and if so how does it combine with NodeExecution and EffectAttempt when deriving the conclusion?
options: Read EffectApproval as well as NodeExecution and EffectAttempt, with a `requested` approval producing `owner_approval` waiting
Derive the conclusion only from NodeExecution and EffectAttempt, requiring the approval wait to be represented in those records
set_aside.default_guess: Read EffectApproval as an authoritative third record source; a `requested` approval makes the element wait and supplies its approval_id.

set_aside.subject: Meaning of no approval being requested
set_aside.text: “when no approval of the element is requested”
set_aside.question: Does this mean that no approval currently has status `requested`, or that no EffectApproval has ever been requested for the element?
options: No approval record has ever been requested for the element
set_aside.default_guess: Interpret it as no approval currently has status `requested`, so an approved first approval with no NodeExecution makes the element `not reached` and ready to send.
